name: Mokomaro Login Guard Lite
author: mokomaro

sections.description:
Mokomaro Login Guard Lite temporarily restricts password logins after five failed attempts from the same connection address within a fixed 15-minute window. Restrictions last 15 minutes. Successful logins clear that connection’s counter.

Administrators can review up to 100 recent connection summaries and clear all counters and restrictions under Settings > Mokomaro Login Guard Lite.

All included functionality is free without a trial period. There are no locked premium features, remote license checks, telemetry, external libraries, external update servers or external API requests. This plugin does not include AI analysis, a firewall, malware scanning or file integrity monitoring.

Use only one login limiter at a time. Disable any previous version or other login-limiting plugin before enabling this plugin.

Privacy and data retention

The plugin stores an HMAC-SHA256 connection identifier derived from REMOTE_ADDR and a site secret, failed-attempt counts, window and restriction expiry timestamps, and the most recent failure timestamp in a local database table. This identifier is pseudonymous, not anonymous. Raw IP addresses, usernames, passwords, request bodies and user agents are not stored. Administrators see a shortened identifier. Daily WP-Cron cleanup removes summaries older than seven days when no restriction is active; low-traffic sites may run cleanup later. Uninstall removes this plugin’s table and scheduled task. Deactivation stops the task and retains records.

Important limitations

Verify REMOTE_ADDR identifies the real visitor at the web server before enabling, especially behind a CDN or reverse proxy. Forwarded headers are deliberately ignored. Shared IP addresses can restrict legitimate users. This initial version supports single-site installations only. Password resets remain available; administrators with no active session can wait for the restriction to expire or disable the plugin using their hosting file manager. This is a login limiter, not comprehensive site protection. Application passwords, external SSO and authentication systems bypassing WordPress’s authenticate/wp_login_failed hooks are outside scope. Other authentication plugins may affect behavior; test compatibility first.
sections.installation:
1. Back up your test site and database.
  2. Upload the mokomaro-login-guard-lite folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  3. Activate on a single-site test installation.
  4. Open Settings > Mokomaro Login Guard Lite.
  5. Test login failure limits and recovery before production use.
sections.faq:
Is a paid license required?

No. All functionality included in this plugin is free without a time limit.

Does it send data to external AI services?

No. This plugin does not use AI or make external requests.

Where are translations managed?

Translations are managed through translate.wordpress.org and delivered by WordPress language packs. This package does not contain bundled translation files. Until a translation is available, the interface uses English.

1.0.0
